Marta: i'll take backups + measured restore section in the runbook, include WAL tail checks and snapshot manifest validation.

Marta: from last dry-run: restore complete but caches cold. adding KV warmup measurement and a staggered reconnect helper.
DevOps-bot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal Wed 08:00 PT. Checklist will post 30m prior.
Leah: owners summary:
- Owen: routing-sanity.sh + cron pre-check. due Tue EOD.
- Marta: restore_runbook.md updates (manifest, WAL, measured restore + cache warmup). due Tue EOD.
- Leah: schedule rehearsal, reduce DNS TTLs, coordinate oncall overlap.
Owen: snippet i'll add to the runbook:
```
bgp-diff --baseline /opt/baselines/bgp.json --current /tmp/current.json || exit 1
```
Marta: manifest check snippet:
```
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups-prod --key snapshots/$(date -I)/manifest.json || exit 1
jq -r '.checksums[]' manifest.json | sha256sum -c - || exit 2
```
